build_bccd_dataset_builder: build a tensorflow dataset builder for the Blood Cell Count and Detection dataset with image and bounding box annotations
create_builder_info: create dataset info with image features, filename text, and objects sequence containing class labels and bounding boxes
run_split_generators: run split generators to download and extract the BCCD dataset and split into train, validation, and test sets
generate_examples: generate examples by parsing XML annotations and JPEG images to yield labeled bounding box objects per image
review_builder_class: review the Builder class that extends GeneratorBasedBuilder for the BCCD blood cell detection dataset
